# GERNAS attribute reference (registry 2026.10.0)

Every attribute the Gernas SDK can emit. SDK code references these only through
`gernas.Ctx`; the Collector allow-list and redaction matrix are generated from the same source.

Legend: **req** always / conditional / never · **sens** sensitivity class · **card** cardinality class ·
**rollup** may slice a report · **action** default PDPL action.

## 1. business — owner: FAB DAI

Business context binding a signal to a use case, application and line of business.

| Constant | Key | Type | req | sens | card | rollup | action | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ctx.BUSINESS_DOMAIN` | `gernas.business_domain` | string | always | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `retail_pricing` | Line of business that owns the use case |
| `Ctx.USE_CASE_ID` | `gernas.use_case_id` | string | always | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `UC-PRICING-001` | Registered GERNAS use-case identifier |
| `Ctx.APPLICATION_ID` | `gernas.application_id` | string | always | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `agent-mesh` | Application hosting the use case |
| `Ctx.CHANNEL` | `gernas.channel` | string (`web`, `api`, `cli`, `devui`, `a2a`, `batch`) | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `api` | Channel through which the request arrived |
| `Ctx.BUSINESS_OUTCOME` | `gernas.business_outcome` | string (`success`, `partial`, `failure`, `abandoned`) | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `success` | Use-case specific outcome of the request |

| `Ctx.HITL_TIMEOUT_S` | `gernas.hitl.timeout_s` | double | conditional | internal | bounded | no | keep | `300` | Configured approval timeout |

## 15. evaluation — owner: MRM

Links runs to offline/online evaluation results and user feedback (gap-analysis domain).

| Constant | Key | Type | req | sens | card | rollup | action | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ctx.EVAL_ID` | `gernas.evaluation.id` | string | conditional | internal | unbounded | no | keep | `eval_1` | Evaluation run id |
| `Ctx.EVAL_METRIC` | `gernas.evaluation.metric` | string | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `faithfulness` | Evaluation metric |
| `Ctx.EVAL_SCORE` | `gernas.evaluation.score` | double | conditional | internal | unbounded | no | keep | `0.91` | Evaluation score |
| `Ctx.EVAL_DATASET` | `gernas.evaluation.dataset` | string | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `golden_pricing_v2` | Evaluation dataset |
| `Ctx.FEEDBACK_SCORE` | `gernas.feedback.score` | double | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `1` | End-user feedback score |

## 16. memory — owner: Agent Runtime

Agent memory reads and writes (gap-analysis domain).

| Constant | Key | Type | req | sens | card | rollup | action | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ctx.MEMORY_OPERATION` | `gernas.memory.operation` | string (`read`, `write`, `delete`, `summarize`) | always | public | bounded | yes | keep | `read` | Memory operation |
| `Ctx.MEMORY_STORE` | `gernas.memory.store` | string | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `conversation_jsonl` | Memory backend |
| `Ctx.MEMORY_HIT` | `gernas.memory.hit` | boolean | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `True` | Read found data (read ops only) |
| `Ctx.MEMORY_STALE` | `gernas.memory.stale` | boolean | conditional | internal | bounded | yes | keep | `False` | Data read was stale |
| `Ctx.MEMORY_SIZE_BYTES` | `gernas.memory.size_bytes` | int | always | internal | unbounded | no | keep | `2048` | Size of the data read or written |
| `Ctx.MEMORY_ITEM_COUNT` | `gernas.memory.item_count` | int | conditional | internal | bounded | no | keep | `6` | Items read or written |

| `HITL` | `hitl.approval` | `trace_hitl` | INTERNAL | `HITL_TICKET_ID`, `HITL_ACTION`, `HITL_OUTCOME`, `HITL_WAITED_MS` |
| `RAG` | `rag.retrieve` | `trace_rag` | INTERNAL | `RETRIEVAL_DURATION_MS`, `RESULT_COUNT`, `EMPTY_RESULT`, `QUERY_HASH` |
| `RETRIEVAL` | `retrieval.search` | `trace_retrieval` | CLIENT | `QUERY_HASH`, `RESULT_COUNT`, `RETRIEVAL_DURATION_MS` |
| `EMBEDDING` | `embedding.create` | `trace_embedding` | CLIENT | `EMBED_MODEL`, `EMBED_BATCH_SIZE`, `EMBED_LATENCY_MS` |
| `MEMORY` | `memory.{operation}` | `trace_memory` | INTERNAL | `MEMORY_OPERATION`, `MEMORY_SIZE_BYTES` |
